# JRNY Plan

JRNY Plan creates group scheduling links and collects complete availability ballots.

The deployed `/llms.txt` endpoint publishes the configured scheduling inbox and complete machine-readable email protocol. Email scheduling is available only when that endpoint names an email destination.

Send a plain-text email with subject `Create schedule` or `Create decision`. The sender must already have a verified JRNY Plan account with the same address. Put one JSON object between `JRNY_SELECT_REQUEST_V1` and `END_JRNY_SELECT_REQUEST`. The JSON requires `"kind": "schedule"` or `"kind": "decision"`.

Schedule fields: `kind`, `title`, `visibility`, `timezone`, `durationMinutes`, `votingClosesAt`, and `candidates`. Use ISO 8601 timestamps with `Z` or an explicit UTC offset. Use either `candidates.exact` or `candidates.range`, never both. Invited schedules also require `inviteEmails`. Optional `decisions` array creates attached decisions that inherit schedule access. Each attached decision needs `title`, `selectMode`, and `options`.

Standalone decision fields: `kind`, `title`, `visibility`, `selectMode`, and `options`. Invited decisions require `inviteEmails`. `closesAt` is optional.

Completion is an email reply containing the created URLs. A validation reply means nothing was created. Retrying one AgentMail event does not create a duplicate.
